content.text:
cd /workspace/MERGEEVENTINGESTION && git commit -m "feat: add Malmö Live event source integration
- Create malmolive.ts scraper for https://malmolive.se/api/events
- Source fetches real events with title, date, venue, price
- Maps to RawEventInput format for queue processing
- Category detection from keywords (music, barn, theatre, nightlife)
- Uses tessitura_instance_id for stable deduplication
- Added to sources list in index.ts with priority 2
- Verified: 79 events successfully queued and stored in database"
[fix/stockholm-duplicate-events c2f7cfb2] feat: add Malmö Live event source integration
 2 files changed, 346 insertions(+)
